name: pagination
useFor: Use under a list or table that is split into pages (the changelog, the blog, a table of runs). Show the first and last pages, one or two either side of the current one and PaginationEllipsis for the gaps. Mark the current page with isActive and a page that leads nowhere with aria-disabled. Use bar to center it in a 48px row under a table.
constraints: A filled ink key for the current page
More than about seven page keys at once
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website's compact keys (.button--s, .button--line) and nav items (.hn__top); the site pages its changelog and blog without numbered keys
title: Pagination
description: 32px ghost hexagon page keys whose wash hexagon appears under the pointer, the current page as the outlined hexagon, and Previous and Next with still arrows.
